one_liner_zh: 禮來EPS超預期逾9%，GLP-1減重與糖尿病藥需求火熱。
one_liner_en: Eli Lilly beats EPS by over 9% on red-hot GLP-1 obesity and diabetes demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+9.14%，營收192.9億美元，受惠減重藥強勁放量。
ai_view_zh: 訊號強勁正向：EPS超預期9%，GLP-1減重藥需求結構性強勁，禮來居產業領先地位。短中期股價由Zepbound/Mounjaro放量驅動，產能擴張為關鍵變數。追蹤指標：減重藥營收與處方量、產能利用率、口服GLP-1臨床進展、競品上市時程。40倍本益比已反映高成長，產能與管線兌現是維持溢價的關鍵；任何供給或臨床失誤恐引發回檔。
ai_view_en: Signal strongly positive: EPS beat by 9% amid structurally strong GLP-1 obesity demand, with Lilly an industry leader. Near to mid-term, the stock is driven by Zepbound/Mounjaro ramp, with capacity expansion the key variable. Track: obesity-drug revenue and scripts, capacity utilization, oral GLP-1 trial progress, and competitor launch timing. A 40x P/E prices in high growth; delivering on capacity and pipeline is key to the premium, while any supply or clinical misstep could trigger a pullback.
highlights_zh: EPS 7.54美元，超出預期6.91美元，驚喜幅度9.14%。
單季營收192.9億美元，GLP-1類藥物（Mounjaro/Zepbound）為主要動能。
減重與糖尿病市場需求遠超供給，產能擴張持續推進。
新藥管線（口服GLP-1等）提供長期成長潛力。
本益比40.19倍，反映市場對減重藥龍頭的成長溢價。
highlights_en: EPS of $7.54 beat the $6.91 estimate by 9.14%.
Quarterly revenue of $19.29B was driven by GLP-1 drugs (Mounjaro/Zepbound).
Obesity and diabetes demand far outstrips supply; capacity expansion continues.
Pipeline (oral GLP-1 and others) offers long-term growth potential.
P/E of 40.19 reflects a growth premium for the obesity-drug leader.
risks_zh: 產能瓶頸可能限制短期營收兌現。
競爭加劇（如諾和諾德及新進者）可能壓縮定價。
高估值對任何臨床或銷售不及預期高度敏感。
risks_en: Capacity bottlenecks may cap near-term revenue realization.
Intensifying competition (e.g., Novo Nordisk and new entrants) could pressure pricing.
High valuation is sensitive to any clinical or sales disappointment.
